title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates ordertemplates so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Versions and build:
  - Module version is now 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, `openmrsPlatformVersion` is 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, `webservicesRestVersion` is 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and `openmrs-bom` is imported.
  - Builds with Java 21 and `-parameters`.
  - `openmrs-web` moves to the omod only, because on the api test classpath it breaks the api context tests.
- `config.xml` now sets `require_version` to 3.0.0.
- `OrderTemplate`: `javax.persistence` is now `jakarta.persistence`, and the removed `@Type(type = "text")` is now `@JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.LONGVARCHAR)`.
- `HibernateOrderTemplatesDao`:
  - The removed Criteria queries are now HQL, with the same filters, `orderTemplateId desc` ordering and retired handling. Each query join-fetches `drug` and `concept`, so it runs as one statement however many drugs it returns.
  - It uses Hibernate's `SessionFactory` (`sessionFactory` bean) instead of `DbSessionFactory`.
  - Saves go through `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate`, and deletes use `remove`.
- `OrderTemplatesResource` now also declares `"3.*"` in `supportedOpenmrsVersions`. Without it, the resource is "Unknown resource" on 3.0. `javax.validation` is now `jakarta.validation`.
- Tests are migrated to JUnit 5, with no assertion changes. `release.yml` uses Java 21.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` passes (16 tests).
- I deployed the omod on openmrs-core master (`mvn jetty:run`, MySQL 8) alongside the other ported O3 modules:
  - All modules started, and the server log has no errors from this module.
  - Logging in through the UI works.
- Over REST:
  - Creating an order template returns 201.
  - Searching by concept and reading `v=full` work, and the JSON `template` round-trips.
  - Purge returns 204.

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests

title: O3-5519: Add BOT_GH_TOKEN to build workflow secrets
body:
## Description
Ticket Link - https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5519
Ticket ID - O3-5519

## Summary
The shared OWASP Dependency Check workflow (openmrs-contrib-gha-workflows) has been updated to automatically push generated vulnerability reports to the central dashboard repository (openmrs-contrib-dependency-vulnerability-dashboard). To support this, the reusable workflow now requires the GH_BOT_TOKEN secret to be passed by calling repositories. Without it, the workflow cannot push reports to the dashboard.

## Change
Added `BOT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.OMRS_BOT_GH_TOKEN }}` to the secrets block in `.github/workflows/build.yml`.
